svg.text: MeshChat LoRa Relay - complete wiring (ESP32 DevKit V1)
Firmware 1.5 default pins. Parts marked (optional) can be left out.

g.text: ANT (pin 9): 433 MHz antenna or 17 cm wire
3.3 V ONLY - 5 V destroys the RA-02.
1k + 2k divider on both lines (5 V -> 3.3 V)
The blue LED on the DevKit is already on GPIO 2.
Add this only for an outside LED.
Passive buzzer plays our tones; active one has its own pitch.
Louder speaker: drive through a transistor.
USB 5 V, at least 500 mA (good cable or power bank)
Colours: orange 3.3V | red 5V | black GND | blue SCK / CLK | green MISO / SCL | purple MOSI / SDA | cyan NSS / DATA | pink RST / LED | brown DIO0 / buzzer

svg.text: I2C bus: same SDA/SCL as the LCD (no extra GPIO)
Keep 5-30 cm from ESP32 and RA-02
No sensor: relay works as before,
A dot = wires joined. Wires that cross without a dot are NOT connected.
Updated for firmware 1.5: BMP280 weather sensor added on the shared I2C bus (GPIO 21 / 22).
